description: Intent i006 (SNAPSHOT=s02, BRANCH=and-presence-guard) complete. One high-confidence finding: drivers/net/ieee802154/mac802154_hwsim.c:421-431, function hwsim_new_edge_nl() (.doit for MAC802154_HWSIM_CMD_NEW_EDGE). The required-attribute guard "if (!info->attrs[MAC802154_HWSIM_ATTR_RADIO_ID] && !info->attrs[MAC802154_HWSIM_ATTR_RADIO_EDGE]) return -EINVAL;" (lines 421-423) uses the logically inverted &&-join, so a generic-netlink NEW_EDGE message that omits exactly one of the two required attributes passes validation. The absent slot is then dereferenced without any covering check: line 425 passes info->attrs[MAC802154_HWSIM_ATTR_RADIO_EDGE] directly into nla_parse_nested_deprecated() (NULL deref inside the helper when the message supplies RADIO_ID but omits RADIO_EDGE), and line 431 calls nla_get_u32() on info->attrs[MAC802154_HWSIM_ATTR_RADIO_ID] (NULL deref when the message supplies RADIO_EDGE but omits RADIO_ID). Evidence: family policy hwsim_genl_policy (lines 579-583) marks RADIO_ID as plain NLA_U32 and RADIO_EDGE as plain NLA_NESTED with no required coverage, op has GENL_DONT_VALIDATE_STRICT, so no other layer proves non-NULL; untrusted source is the attacker-supplied netlink attribute set; the sibling handlers in the same file (hwsim_del_edge_nl at 483-484, the fixed seed instance, and hwsim_set_edge_lqi at 531-532) both use the correct '||', confirming the '&&' in NEW_EDGE is the seed-mechanism inversion bug. Result: kernel NULL-pointer dereference/oops (local DoS) reachable with CAP_NET_ADMIN over a user namespace. 12 candidates classified: 1 reported (hwsim_new_edge_nl), 11 safe (nl80211_new_station AID at-least-one-of-two with guarded else-use; net/ieee802154/nl-mac.c assoc/disassoc alternative-address and optional-param skip patterns; nfc start_poll/llc_set_params; devlink reload reply-suppression check; genetlink ctrl_dumppolicy_start either-or family id). Limitations: impact asserted from helper semantics, no runtime reproducer; module-load reachability not verified; tb[]-based '&&' guards outside genl doit scope (net/ipv6/addrconf.c:5804, net/core/rtnetlink.c:2235, net/core/lwt_bpf.c:388, net/netfilter/nft_tproxy.c:199, drivers/net/vxlan.c:1287) only guard-level triaged and deferred to the rtnl branch. Artifact: agent-state/findings/i006.json with quote verified verbatim at lines 421-431.
